prices.note: USD per million tokens, input and output; cache reads priced as input, cache writes at 1.25x input

files.traces: traces/<day>.jsonl: the .agent-traces lines inside the window, same shape as the dev proxy log
files.ledger: ledger.jsonl: one row per run, traces as 1-based inclusive line ranges into traces/
files.signals: signals.md: pass rates, failing checks, retry codes, spend, digests and trace tallies (newer rounds only), generated by scripts/e2e-admin/probe/signals.ts with the archive
files.screenshots: $AGENT_UI_EVIDENCE_DIR (default `~/Library/Caches/agent-ui/evidence` on macOS, `${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-~/.cache}/agent-ui/evidence` elsewhere)/<round>/<run>/turn-<n>.png: local cache outside the repo, may be gone; report.json names each one by absolute path
files.readme: README.md: the entry file, what each file is, where it came from and how to read it
